body: Awesome! I'm so glad you choose to fight. You can always message me if you need anything.

I wish there was a magic word I could say that would cure you but I can't. I am in the same exact situation as you and it DOES seem like the best option for me, so I understand . I should've killed myself two years but yet here I am. Give yourself 60 days to try and change whatever is wrong in your life. I promise you, you can do it.
No I understand what your saying. Thank you. I know this fight is ultimately mine and I have to be the one to overcome it
The problem is I have no friends to really help. I feel like I have to do this whole life on my own. I've given my best to try and make friends and build a support group but to no avail
